note: Butler County AL has no county zoning ordinance for unincorporated land. The City of Greenville (county seat) publishes its zoning only as a 2023 zoning map PDF and a regulations PDF, with no ArcGIS or other queryable district layer. Georgiana and McKenzie showed no zoning service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Butler County AL zoning returned nothing; the county geoportal (butler-county-geoportal-bucogis.hub.arcgis.com) exposed no zoning district layer.
